title: Owner confirms or amends milestone M1
goal: The next milestone is agreed before any record is planned from it
acceptance: Owner picks option A, B or C in docs/ROADMAP.md
The roadmap row's Status becomes Agreed (or the page is amended) in the same change that plans its records
privacy: Instructions and docs only; no personal data.
validation: The owner's reply (option A, B or C, with any amendment) is recorded on F-004 with its date
escalation: None: the owner's decision is the step

effort.basis: Owner decision; about a quarter hour of reading.
